title: Version 1.10.0
body:
Version 1.10.0

June 23rd, 2023

New Content:

  • Secret Update Friday Content (TLA)

Changes:

  • Tall Refined Axe is now boxed in stores, legacy boxes are now golden
  • Reduced price of the Tall Refined Axe
  • All 3 doors can now be scaled down to 0.25 on the Z axis (0.5 prior)

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed error with tree chopping line client preview
